name: MovingHouse

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: Moving involves several one-time expenses alongside normal monthly bills

scenario_template.topic: Listing expected moving expenses
scenario_template.note: They discuss deposits, movers, transportation, supplies, and setup costs

scenario_template.topic: Underestimating the total cost of relocating
scenario_template.note: Several small one-time expenses were not included initially

scenario_template.topic: Creating a temporary moving budget
scenario_template.note: They want to protect their normal monthly budget while preparing

scenario_template.topic: Separating moving costs from ongoing household expenses
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps identify one-time and recurring costs

scenario_template.topic: Choosing which moving services to pay for
scenario_template.note: They compare convenience against cost

scenario_template.topic: Planning for unexpected setup costs after the move
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests leaving a post-move buffer

scenario_template.topic: Finalizing the moving fund
scenario_template.note: They know how much needs to be saved before moving day

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
